Field note · 4 min

Designing with constraints

Constraints turn an open field into a tractable space. A useful system states what can vary, what must remain stable, and who may change either.

Make boundaries visible

Document limits close to the component or workflow they govern. Visible boundaries are easier to test and harder to bypass accidentally.

Test the edges

Fixtures should include ordinary cases, repeated structures, and one deliberately broken example.
